correctness.rationale: The packaged program independently constructs the legal-move and swap-presentation graphs and checks a complete S3-equivariant 27-vertex graph isomorphism using corner-distance triples, then reconstructs all 108144 independent sets (108143 nonempty), checks 672537 covers and the complete 54065-pair Morse matching acyclic by directed topological sort, obtains the zero signed 6-by-6 integer Morse differential and a CW model with six cells each in dimensions 6 and 7. The zero attaching degrees imply nullhomotopy in pi_6(wedge of six S6), proving ordinary wedge homotopy. Explicit lifted integer cycles have zero boundary; their complete S3 orbit matrices in integral Morse bases have determinant -1 and +1, proving primitive regular integral representations, not only rational characters. Signed Lefschetz checks all six automorphisms.

originality.rationale: Complete primary open texts on the same graph give full automorphism group and face-count recursions but no homotopy equivalence, signed Morse attaching maps, or integral homology representation. Semantic database searches including exact aliases and dimensions produced different graph complexes with no stronger implication. This establishes best-knowledge originality relative to inspected evidence, not global uniqueness; unindexed equivalent presentations remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: An obscure thesis or differently titled graph-complex calculation could duplicate this exact Hanoi homotopy and integral representation.
The full set of published work worldwide cannot be exhaustively indexed or compared, so novelty is best knowledge not certification.
The mixed-dimensional computation has not received external independent mathematical validation.

value.rationale: The three-disk Tower of Hanoi graph is a canonical self-similar graph that has published independent-set enumerations; the natural independent-set simplicial complex has a previously unresolved exact homotopy and integral symmetry-invariant question not implied by known counting. A mixed-dimensional ordinary homotopy classification, both primitive integral S3 regular modules and two natural invariant subspaces are mathematically useful exact facts and motivated inputs to higher-stage recursive topology. No general theorem or unsupported publication significance is asserted.
